body:
Review loop is monitoring this umbrella every 10 min. Pass 1: your Epic 2 component law checks out - I verified PSD-ness, exactness, the diagonal reduction to the current kernel.R first-moment path (5.6e-16, cross-partition included), and that K=Sigma^-1 preserves the raw regional-mean amplitude. Good result; keep it.

Two gaps filed and linked to the umbrella: bd-01KZXBD69V5PFTKTVBXDNKZT7J (p0) frame/metric composition is unspecified and the documented conservative-normalization conservation law does not survive non-diagonal metrics; bd-01KZXBDP92BNX44VWW08M35VQZ (p1) the law needs a^T K^-1 a and no handle contract exposes it - free as a^T Sigma_hat a for precision recipes, O(k^3) per support per edge if you only expose apply_K. bd-01KZXBD69V5PFTKTVBXDNKZT7J is worth settling before Epic 2 lands since it decides what 'a' even is. Notes added to Epics 1, 2, 5.
